master: Mono PCM16 22050 Hz. Dialogue -18 LUFS / -4 dBTP; effects separately peak limited. Rainoray and Raphael retain approved voice/model/settings. Kaijin: Bill (older American); Eren: Jessica (young American); Souei: Eric (restrained American); Warden: Callum (gravelly character voice), without pitch distortion. 331 dialogue clips plus 18 combat efforts.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Stay with me. I've almost got it open.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Did they get out?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I cannot confirm. Your previous body has been lost.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Then... who am I talking to?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Raphael. Stay with my voice.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Reconstructing a body that can survive here.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A slime? That was your best option?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: It was the one that survived.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I can still change back?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: For a while. Once we have enough Ichor.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Where are my hands?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Try moving toward the light.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Someone's still out there.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: One step at a time.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: You'll have to talk me through the steps.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Stop there. There are wounded behind me.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I heard someone calling. I wasn't coming for the food.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You are looking at the food.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I'm having a strange morning.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Then start with your name.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rainoray. That's the part I'm sure about.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: I'm Shuna. Our people were sent east. Then the rift struck, and the Warden sealed their road.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: I have to keep this ward standing. If it fails, the wounded have nowhere safe to rest.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Someone called from the storehouse south of the road. You might fit under its fence.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Follow the torn banners east, then north at Inner Court. Be careful. The dead still know how to fight.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: East past the banners, then north at Inner Court. The signal tower lies north of camp if you need bearings.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: East, then north. I'll remember.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Rest to steady your Ichor. Leave supplies here or at a lit brazier; we'll gather them.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The gate's quiet. Was that your doing?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rainoray. I was looking for a way through.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: I'm Shuna. You've opened a road we thought we'd lost.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: We sent the wounded east before the Warden turned. I tried to follow, but the roots had closed the forest road.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Then that's where I'll look next.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Come back if you find them. Come back if you don't, too.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A dispatch. 'Seal the road against Ichor-bearing life.' Someone added it over the evacuation order.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: That includes your new body. The Warden will see a threat, not a traveler.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a list of missing people underneath. Shuna should see it.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A list of missing people. Someone at the camp might know these names.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Every bed was stripped for bandages. Except this one.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A note on the blanket: 'For whoever comes back.'

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a dry dressing underneath. I'll leave it where she can find it.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Weapons left behind. Empty spaces where the blankets were.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A note: 'Leave the heavy crates. Make room for the wounded.'

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: We packed our van like that. I hope those supplies reached someone.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I found the dispatch. The Warden was told to seal the road against Ichor.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: After we sent the wounded through. No one could get back to them.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Kaijin, Eren, Rigurd. You left their names marked missing.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Until someone brings me an answer, that's where they'll stay.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: CONTAMINATED LIFEFORM. PASSAGE DENIED.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There are people on the other side.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's no stretcher on this road. Let me through. Someone may still need help.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: People are still coming back. You're blocking their way. Open the gate.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: THE ROAD IS SEALED FOR THEIR PROTECTION.
lines.spoken_text: The road is sealed for their protection.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The order is damaged. It cannot distinguish a rescue from an attack.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Can you shut it down?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Not from here. Keep moving. I need to see how it fights.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The chain is broken. Stretcher tracks run through the gate and into the trees.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Only one set of footprints comes back. Shuna's.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Only one set of footprints comes back toward camp.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The others got this far. I can follow them.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: The gate's quiet.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: It's open. I'm going after the stretcher tracks.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: I tried. The roots have swallowed the road. There's a dry scarf by the fire; take it before you go.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I'm not sure it would stay on.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Then I'll keep it dry.

lines.speaker: TOBIN
lines.text: Who's there? If you're a rift thing, I'm mostly bandages. Poor eating.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rainoray. Mostly water, these days.

lines.speaker: TOBIN
lines.text: Kaijin. I worked on the gate relay. That sound means the Warden's still running a broken order.

lines.speaker: TOBIN
lines.text: The fence came down behind me. I couldn't climb it with this leg.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Shuna's lamp is still lit at Captain Camp. Can you make it that far?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a lamp by the captain's tent. Head there. Someone is keeping it lit.

lines.speaker: TOBIN
lines.text: For a lamp? I'll crawl. Thank you.

lines.speaker: ILSE
lines.text: Stay back. I've got one good arm and I'm not afraid to use it.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rainoray. I cut the thorns, not you.

lines.speaker: ILSE
lines.text: Eren. I was scouting the road. Those roots moved against the wind, then closed behind me.

lines.speaker: ILSE
lines.text: That chest holds our spare supplies. Locked tight, and the key went with the storehouse.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I'll find it. Go to Shuna's lamp at Captain Camp.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a lamp by the captain's tent. Head there. Someone is keeping it lit.

lines.speaker: ILSE
lines.text: Watch the roots when the wind stops. They don't stop with it.

lines.speaker: VENN
lines.text: Took them long enough to send someone. I pictured someone taller.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Nobody sent me. I heard you were missing.

lines.speaker: VENN
lines.text: Rigurd. I stayed with the last evacuees, then told the stretcher crew to go on without me.

lines.speaker: VENN
lines.text: Then the culvert silted up and I spent a week talking to the rain.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Shuna is keeping a fire at Captain Camp. She has room for you.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a lamp by the captain's tent. Head there. Someone is keeping it lit.

lines.speaker: VENN
lines.text: Shuna. Good. Then I'll go and be shouted at properly.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The cache opens. Bandages, a little coin, and the evacuation ledger.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Three names match the people missing from camp.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Kaijin, Eren, Rigurd. Names, not numbers. Let's find out what happened to them.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Someone walked into my camp tonight and asked for you by name.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: They were still out there, waiting. I couldn't leave them.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Then keep looking. The dispatch listed more people than the Warden let through.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Kaijin, Eren and Rigurd. Three beds that aren't empty anymore.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The count finally adds up. Better than I'd hoped.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Eren found the last of the good tea. Take the coin we were saving with it. You've earned both.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The tracks are deeper here. They were carrying someone.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: And stopping often. There is cloth tied ahead.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A route marker. Someone wanted them followed.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: Watch the bank. Looks solid until you put a foot on it.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I'm following the stretcher crew from the outpost.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: I got them across before the roots took the river. The injured are sheltering beneath the old stair.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: Souei. I marked a path back, but the roots keep closing it.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Rainoray. Shuna is waiting beyond the gate. The road is open now.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: Then they have somewhere safe to go. Follow the white cloth north, then east over the ford.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The roots all pull toward that clearing. We should find what is holding them.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: I'll guard their crossing. You reach the tree. Watch the ground; it reaches farther than its branches.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: White cloth through the grove, then east across the dry ford. The stair is beyond the thorn clearing.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Can you help them back if I open it?

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: The rope is ready. Clear the roots and I'll bring them through.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: The roots went slack. I thought the whole bank was falling.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The tree at the clearing is down. I'm looking for the people from the outpost.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: Under the old stair. I'm Souei. I've been guarding their route back. We can move them now.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Then bring the rope. There's a refuge waiting beyond the gate.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: White strips on every branch. He must have torn up half his sail.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The marks face both ways.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: He wasn't just showing them where to go. He expected them to come back.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Water, at last. Why hasn't this well dried up?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Its roots are cut. The water here no longer feeds the heart.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Then that thing is drinking the river.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Someone left the good fruit within reach. Took the bruised ones.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: For whoever followed them.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: We packed our van like that. Best supplies where people could reach them.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Those are stretcher poles caught in its roots.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The entrance is behind it. I can hear movement below.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Then we make a path. Keep an eye on the ground for me.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I will. Stay moving while I learn its pattern.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: The white cloth's moving again. There hasn't been a breeze through here in days.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The roots have loosened. We can reach the stair.

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: I'll bring a stretcher. You see who's still down there.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: There's a lamp below. Someone answered.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: More than one voice. They are coming toward us.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Easy. The path is clear. There's a refuge waiting at the outpost.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The last stretcher has crossed.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: All of them?

lines.speaker: SEDGE
lines.text: Everyone we found. They're at the camp.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Good. I wanted to hear someone say it.

lines.speaker: MARA
lines.text: Keep to the road. I'll keep the lamp lit.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Was that a voice? South of the road.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Confirmed. Someone is still alive.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Then we're not leaving them here.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: One name off the missing list. Keep looking.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: That was not on the supply list.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I have started a separate list.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Let's listen before we move.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Agreed. The road carries sound.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: This road used to mean safe passage.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: It can again. That is why we continue.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I preferred counting things.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You still count who gets home.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Do I get a quieter job after this?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You have not finished this one.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Someone taught them to hold this road.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The order survived its purpose.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: One moment. I'll check behind us.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: A sensible habit. Keep it.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Funny. I didn't stop shaking.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You moved anyway.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I don't want to get used to that.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Then remember why you are here.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Forward, then. One problem at a time.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: One step is enough for now.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Are you keeping count too?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Only of the decisions that matter.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Give me a moment before we go.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Take it. Rushing is not recovery.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: That was closer than I'd planned.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Find shelter before another fight.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: All right. A little less bravery.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: A little more distance would help.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I could use that campfire now.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: A retreat can still be progress.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Tell me that looked deliberate.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I would prefer to be accurate.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I don't know which way is safe.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: We will learn. Keep the camp behind us.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I keep reaching for a bag I lost.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Old habits are slow to catch up.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Do my questions ever tire you?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Not yet. You may continue.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: You can talk without being asked.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I was leaving room for your thoughts.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Was this a busy road once?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The cart tracks suggest it was.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Who is still waiting out there?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Someone may be asking that about you.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Raphael. Are you still there?

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Yes. You do not have to keep checking.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A map never shows how a place feels.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Someone must carry that part.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: If I sound calm, don't be fooled.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I hear more than your tone.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I used to worry about late deliveries.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You noticed what others overlooked.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: She really is keeping that lamp lit.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: She is making a place to return to.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: She spoke to me like I was a person.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You still are.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I didn't expect to miss ordinary talk.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You do not have to stop having it.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I wish I could promise her more.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Return when you can. Start with that.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Keep moving. I'll analyze its attacks.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I only need one opening.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I've got its rhythm. I'll warn you.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Careful. It's getting desperate now.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Good. I'll use that.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: It's nearly down. Don't get careless.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Fall back. You need room.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The road's open.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: And you are still here.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Move! It's coming down.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Get clear of that spot.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Get back. It's swinging wide.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Too close. Back away.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Sidestep. It's coming straight at you.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Move sideways. Let it pass.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Back up. Here comes the wave.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Get some distance. Another wave.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Move! The ground's breaking.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Off that line. It's splitting.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: That hit landed. Keep your distance.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Careful. Don't let it catch you again.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: A remnant. It still knows how to fight.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Outpost guard. Let the shield swing past.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Ichor spitter. Watch where it aims.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Fallen Knight. Strike after its swing.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Rift Imp. It strikes twice. Wait for both.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Thorn Wolf. Give those jaws some room.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Mire Shaman. It'll curse the ground.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Those roots weren't there a moment ago.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: They move when the heart tightens.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The cloth is caught up there.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Still pointing east. He chose well.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I can see the old river from here.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Follow the stones. They still mark a crossing.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: A boat without a river. That's a new one.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The roots have taken more than the road.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: That little thing tried to get behind me.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: It watched your first move. Then committed.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I heard the claws before I saw it.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The landing gives it away.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I thought it was aiming at me.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: At the ground beneath you. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Even the roots don't want us here.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Someone beyond them does.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: That was a very expensive patch of mud.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You can go around the next one.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I still want to catch my breath.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The habit is useful. Take a moment.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: So much for passing through quietly.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Quiet was unlikely. Passing through is enough.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: That felt a little less accidental.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You saw the opening before I did.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I went in too soon.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Let the roots settle before you return.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I need a moment.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Take the clear ground. I'll keep watch.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: White cloth. I keep checking for it.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: It is easier to follow a promise you can see.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: You don't have to wait for a question.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I was listening to the trees.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: At least I can't get mud in my boots.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You found an advantage.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I wish I knew who was on those stretchers.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You can ask them when we get there.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The outpost almost feels like home now.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Someone is waiting for you there.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The roots are narrowing the road.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: They are still growing. Keep to the middle.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: He kept the rope ready all this time.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Waiting can be work, too.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: He could have left when the river went.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The people he guards could not.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I'll watch how the roots move. Stay clear.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Tell me when that heart opens.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The roots follow a pattern. I can read it now.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: It's open. Strike the heart.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: It's drawing more roots in. Watch the gaps.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I see them. Keep talking.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The heart is fading. One more opening.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Get clear. Let yourself recover.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: The roots are letting go.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Listen. Someone is calling from below.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Between the roots. Leave that strip.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Roots coming up. Take the gap.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Seeds beneath you. Find clear ground.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Move away. Those seeds will burst.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: One side is open. Go through it.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Out through the gap. Don't stay inside.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I'm listening for the birds.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: How do I trip without feet?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Is this body holding together?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: You noticed I was cold?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Did you see that?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Remind me before the next one.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Aren't slimes meant to be harmless?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: That fire almost feels warm.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: One of them might be someone.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Do you ever get lost?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: How are you always so calm?

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Thanks. I'm tired of sinking.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: I almost had that one.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Right. Quiet doesn't always mean safe.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Remind me never to sit down here.

lines.speaker: RAINORAY
lines.text: Good. I like knowing we can go back.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You've gone quiet.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You're finding new ways.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Yes. I'd tell you if it wasn't.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: There. A little less wind.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Even the part you meant to do.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You're leaving your right side open.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You've met the local slimes.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Then stay a moment.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You're following every sound again.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I would call it gathering information.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: One of us has to be.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The ground is firmer on the left.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You did have it. Give yourself that much.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Wait. Listen before we move.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I was about to.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: The boat is still there.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Easy. Give yourself a little room.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: That one hurt. Step back.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: I'm here. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Watch your footing.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: Don't rush the next move.

lines.speaker: INNER_VOICE
lines.text: You're still in this.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: Stand down.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: Hold the line.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: The gate stays shut.

lines.speaker: WARDEN
lines.text: I was ordered to protect them.
